title: Quick start
description: Four steps: the frame, the zones, the parts, the threats.

steps.title: The frame
steps.guidance:
Name the model and say in a sentence or two what it covers.

* Use a name that people will find again.
* Say what is inside the model and what is left out.

steps.title: Trust zones
steps.guidance:
Name the areas that trust each other, for example the internet, a DMZ and the internal network.

* Give each zone a trust rating from 0 (nobody is trusted) to 100 (fully trusted).
* Parts in one zone may rely on each other; a line between two zones is where the trust changes.

steps.title: Components
steps.guidance:
List every process, data store and outside party that takes part.

* *Process*: code that runs.
* *Data store*: a place where data rests.
* *External entity*: a person or a system that is not yours.

Put each component in the zone it runs in.

steps.title: Threats
steps.guidance:
For each component ask what could go wrong and write it down as a threat.

* Say it in one sentence that an outsider can follow.
* Rate how likely it is and how bad it would be, from 0 to 100.
* Keep the threat *open* until it is decided.
